metadata.description: Plugins that surround QA Vault, an MCP-native test-management platform: QA practice and e2e automation through the QA Vault MCP, a quality loop for AI-assisted development, and project docs as an auto-loaded context layer. Installable in Claude Code and Codex CLI.

plugins.name: codelore
plugins.description: Project documentation as an auto-loaded context layer for AI sessions. Three skills: write implementation docs, bulk-migrate existing ones, and route the relevant docs into context before planning, debugging, or onboarding.

plugins.name: qa-vault-skills
plugins.description: Skills that make an AI agent a QA practitioner for the QA Vault platform: author, maintain, search, and organize manual UI test scenarios — including the search abstracts that power two-vector semantic search — apply recorded lessons learned to find coverage gaps and suspected bugs, and turn manual cases into automated Playwright e2e tests: generate, heal, run, and report, closed-loop through the QA Vault MCP.

plugins.name: quality-loop
plugins.description: A quality loop for AI-generated code: skeptical exploratory QA of plans and code, a contract-driven testing discipline for unit and integration suites (verified by mutation testing and provoked real-infrastructure failures), a deterministic pre-PR Semgrep gate with project-owned rules, and critical triage of Greptile AI reviews — closed by a human-approved ratchet that turns recurring findings into rules. Bring your own Semgrep install and Greptile account.
